title: Resolve Java var types through method-call and static-factory RHS patterns
wanted_capability: methodRegions should provide resolved_type for Java var declarations whose initializer is a method call or known static-factory pattern when a syntax/index-backed return type is available, so extract-method probes do not manually trace declaration sites and callee signatures.
missing_primitive: Java var resolved_type for method-call RHS and known static factories
fallback_used: Probe agent manually searched unresolved var declaration sites, traced a method return type, and inferred a known static factory return type before passing explicit helper parameters.
notes: Follow-on to gap-40d8c31a. Local syntax-only var resolution now covers simple literals/casts/constructors, but this reprobe still spent cells resolving method-call/static-factory RHS forms manually. Keep public notes generic; evidence came from a private Java calculation-stage probe.
resolution_note: Tranche shipped: resolve_var_declaration_type (crates/bbox-refactor/src/java/scope.rs:591) via infer_expression_type (:603) now resolves var RHS for new/array/cast/parens/literals, same-file method calls (unique_same_file_method_return_type :670), and static-factory receivers (is_known_static_factory_method :713). Locked by tests method_regions_resolves_var_type_from_same_file_method_call (tests.rs:10355) and method_regions_resolves_var_type_from_known_static_factory_receiver (tests.rs:10395). Remaining scope (cross-file receiver method calls + jOOQ generic-R newRecord) is tracked in the two child gaps f9db476b and dceee690 — those need a non-facts surface (the facts charter forbids cross-file/LSP state), so this umbrella is closed in favor of the children.
